executive_summary: On June 11, 2026, OFAC added 11 new entities and individuals to the SDN list, removed 2 individuals, and updated 3 entities. The additions primarily target Chinese and Iranian individuals and entities involved in nuclear proliferation and other malicious activities. The removals include Russian individuals previously sanctioned under the Russia-EO14024 program.

notable_entities.name: Domus Trading HK Limited
notable_entities.significance: First-time designation under the IRAN-EO13902 program

notable_entities.name: Union Cuba Petroleo
notable_entities.significance: First-time designation under the CUBA-EO14404 program

notable_entities.name: AHADZADEH Sajjad
notable_entities.significance: Designated under the IFSR and IRAN-CON-ARMS-EO programs

risk_implications.description: The addition of Chinese and Iranian entities involved in nuclear proliferation increases the risk of illicit activities and potential sanctions evasion
The designation of entities involved in international trade may impact global supply chains and trade relationships
The designation of Union Cuba Petroleo may have limited impact on US-Cuba relations

program_highlights.note: Multiple entities designated under this program, highlighting ongoing concerns about nuclear proliferation
Entities and individuals designated under this program, indicating continued focus on Iran-related sanctions

Monitor OFAC updates and ensure timely implementation of new sanctions designations
Review and update internal compliance policies to reflect changing sanctions landscapes
